meta.promptText: Dark spots aur dull skin ke liye India mein konsa vitamin C serum kharidun?

response.text:
India mein dark spots aur dull skin ke liye Vitamin C serums ke kai acche options available hain jo skin ko bright aur glowing banate hain. Aap apni skin type aur experience ke hisaab se niche diye gaye serums me se choose kar sakte hain:

Ye serum beginners aur sensitive skin ke liye best hai. Isme stable **10% Ethyl Ascorbic Acid** aur **Centella Water** hai jo dark spots ko fade karne ke saath skin ko calm rakhta hai.

Agar aapko thodi higher concentration chahiye toh ye 15% formula dullness aur pigmentation ko tezi se target karta hai. Ye **fragrance-free** hai aur natural extracts ke sath skin glow boost karta hai.

Ye serum **15% L-Ascorbic Acid** aur **Vitamin E** ke power-packed combination ke sath aata hai. Ye deep penetration dekar uneven skin tone aur spots ko jaldi theek karne mein madad karta hai.

Isme Vitamin C ke sath **5% Niacinamide** bhi milta hai, jo dark spots ke sath-sath skin barrier ko strengthen karta hai aur oil control mein bhi help karta hai.

Ek budget-friendly aur popular option hai jo lightweight formula ke sath instantly dull skin ko refresh karta hai.
